adjudication.surprise_1: download failed in the first run: the destination folder did not exist and the harness swallowed the CLI error. Harness fixed (creates the folder, records the return code, fails loudly); the archive itself was fine (84 files visible on the Volume). Re-checked with --verify-only, no second archiver run.
adjudication.surprise_2: aggregates counted 0 real / 36 test where the expectation said 3 real / 33 test. ADJUDICATED: the archiver is right and the expectation was a lower bound. The expectation derives test hashes only from FLAGGED records; the 3 items are one sender in linked-ID form (tail 6995), unflagged, decided 10-11 Nov by the founder, i.e. the founder's test phone under its linked-ID identity. The app's own count uses the configured TEST_SENDERS list: /health cohort.participants_seen = 0 over all 75 transcript rows, test_senders listed 2 / seen 2, so that hash is a configured test identity. No real participant has ever used the system.
adjudication.consequence: scripts/answer_path_summary.py classifies by flag + flagged-record hashes only, which UNDER-classifies test identities that carry no flag (here: the linked-ID form). Its 'real' counts are therefore an upper bound on real traffic until it can read the configured list (a small function returning the hashes, or a token-gated /health field).
